profile.headline: Engineering Team Lead at IGS Energy
profile.summary:
Over the years I've contributed to, and managed the development and integration of systems that support and drive operations. I've successfully led design, planning, implementation, and execution of projects to achieve companies goals.

I've led teams of developers using various agile practices in continuous integration environments. I've provided developer support and mentoring. I leverage industry best-practices and emerging technologies to deliver mission critical solutions.

I've overseen infrastructure planning and deployment, supporting multiple remote locations.  I enjoy working with vendors and customers.

Occasionally, I can be found honing my ping-pong skills.

Technologies (ever-updating list):
•  Cloud technologies:  Azure – App Services, Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Redis (Azure)
     AWS - Lambdas, Step Functions, Kinesis
•  database design/implementation: MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, CosmosDB, MongoDB, Azure Storage, DynamoDB
•  Application design/development: C#, ASP.Net MVC, javascript, python, Reactjs
•  UI design/development: jquery, bootstrap, css, html
•  Integrations development: REST API, GraphQL, EDI, RabbitMQ, web services

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer / Tech Lead
positions.description: I lead a team of dedicated engineers managing identity and authorization services in our Readiness platform within the AWS ecosystem - servicing a very large number of users every day.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description: I lead a team of cross functional developers responsible for transforming a legacy architecture into a modern microservices-based solution within the Azure ecosystem.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description: I built and lead a team of cross-disciplinary engineers and IT professionals responsible for empowering and supporting a highly successful e-commerce retailer supplier. We built the infrastructure and wrote the systems that enabled the business to grow from $5M to over $175M in annual revenue, through multiple acquisitions, supporting multiple remote locations.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: web development, product development, application and systems design

volunteerExperiences.description:
Was part of a team that redesigned website for Cleveland Mental Health Services for the Homeless.

Customer chose to move from static html site to WordPress site so they had control over content. Project took 3 days to plan and implement, and consisted of layout, design, and custom programming.

http://www.mhs-inc.org/

Worked over a weekend to upgrade non-profit organizations websites from static HTML to WordPress.

Worked on overall layout and content generation. Implemented client-side javascript widgets and worked closely with web designer.

projects.title: SaaS Order Management System Evaluation
projects.description:
Worked with stakeholders to evaluate multiple software-as-a-service (SaaS) Order Management System (OMS) service
providers. I wrote design documents on how to integrate a new OMS into a legacy architecture,
as well as present new designs on what future architectures could look like for the company.

projects.title: Evaluate and Select Integration Platform As A Service (iPaaS)
projects.description: Evaluate and select iPaaS solutions to bring stronger integration capabilities to the organization. RFQ process involved multiple vendors.  Final selection made in september.
